result.summary: Found 2 issues on the food delivery home screen. The main one is a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card. There is also a minor inconsistency in how the favorite (heart) buttons are styled.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza) shows a '-0%' discount badge. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and looks like the badge is rendering even when no discount is set, or the discount value failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Only render the discount badge when the discount value is greater than 0. Also check that the discount value is populated correctly for this restaurant.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently across the 'Popular right now' cards. On the pizza card the heart sits on a clearly visible dark circular backdrop. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the backdrop is barely distinguishable, so the icon's contrast against the image varies.
issues.suggestion: Use the same semi-opaque circular background on all favorite buttons so they look consistent and stay legible over any image.
